press de pecho inclinado con mancuernas

limitations: Not enough recorded sessions for a reliable 28-day trend

recommendations.text: Track consistent activity IDs, set loads, units and session RPE.
Compare only repeated identical benchmark variants and the same equipment.

interpretation: Observed peak loads are not 1RM estimates. Session-RPE × Garmin recorded minutes is not effective WOD duration. No-day entry is not proof of rest. No medical conclusions or causal effect of night shifts.

Comparar las series de cada ejercicio solo con la misma variante, equipamiento, repeticiones y esfuerzo; el peso pico aislado es descriptivo.

recommendations.message: Registrar otra semana de sesiones comparables antes de valorar una tendencia semanal.
Para comparar WOD, registrar benchmark_id, variante, estándares, tiempo o repeticiones efectivas y RPE.
